name: CaseNonpaintingTextVisibilityHidden
description: SEED contract for the CSS/DOM conformance fixture case "nonpainting-text-visibility-hidden" (invariant). The fixture varies CSS CONSTRUCTS, not prop spaces, so the prop space is deliberately EMPTY: every axis the capture would enumerate is held at nothing, and the whole measurement is the computed truth of one mounted rendering. Construct: a NON-PAINTING element carrying text (visibility: hidden)
